ns2:course.label: Regional Studies in Musicology
ns2:course.description: Seminar devoted to intensive study in the music of specific peoples, states, or geographic regions from around the world. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MUS 528 A (for DMA or MM performance or composition students); graduate standing in Musicology; Music and Sound Studies graduate minor; or consent of instructor.
